name: The Chocolate Double Breasted
pieces: A double breasted chocolate suit, white shirt, dark tie, pocket square, round glasses and brown leather shoes
colour: Chocolate wool with crisp white and warm brown leather
why: Brown tailoring feels warmer than navy and is every bit as sharp.

name: The Cliff Walk
pieces: An off white lace camp collar shirt, wide rust trousers, white trainers and a black cap
colour: Off white floral lace against rust brown
why: One rich colour on the legs lets a quiet, textured top do the talking.

name: The Crochet Shirt
pieces: An open knit crochet shirt over a black tee, layered silver chains and a black watch
colour: Cream crochet with burgundy stripes over black
why: A black tee underneath turns a holiday shirt into something you could wear to dinner.

name: The Embroidered Jacket
pieces: A cream embroidered jacket over a black tee, black trousers, a silver chain and round sunglasses
colour: Cream cotton with rose embroidery over black
why: A detailed jacket shines when everything underneath stays plain.

name: The Patchwork Overshirt
pieces: A patchwork check overshirt, black tee, wide black trousers, a cap and chunky trainers
colour: Burgundy, rust and cream checks over all black
why: Keep everything else black and a loud overshirt suddenly looks considered.

name: The Burgundy Overshirt
pieces: A burgundy overshirt over a black top, printed neckerchief, light wide jeans, a matching cap and a printed tote
why: Matching the cap to the overshirt pulls a casual outfit together.

name: The Brown Set
pieces: A brown camp collar shirt over a white vest, matching brown trousers and white trainers
colour: Head to toe chocolate with a little white
why: A matching set looks sharp straight away, and white trainers keep it relaxed.

name: The Layered Jumper
pieces: A navy jumper over a striped shirt, stone wide trousers, a cap and retro trainers
why: Letting the shirt show at the collar and hem adds depth with no fuss.

name: Fleece and Track Stripes
pieces: A brown teddy fleece, check scarf, cream cap, brown track trousers with white stripes and chunky trainers
colour: Chocolate and cream with a camel check
why: Sporty trousers look grown up when the colours match the rest of the outfit.

name: The Bottle Green Cardigan
pieces: A bottle green cardigan, white tee, silver chain, wide stone trousers, white trainers and a bunch of flowers
colour: Deep green with stone and white
why: Dark green is the easiest way to wear colour without shouting.

name: All Black, One Patch
pieces: A black work shirt with an embroidered chest patch and rolled sleeves, pleated black trousers and black leather shoes
why: When everything is black, one small detail does all the work.

name: The Graphic Tee
pieces: An oversized graphic tee, wide black trousers and a black canvas tote
colour: Black with a flash of orange
why: A boxy tee with wide trousers gives a relaxed shape that still looks deliberate.

name: The Summer Knit
pieces: A striped knit shirt worn open over a white vest, black leather belt and ripped cream jeans
colour: Cream and sage knit with off white denim
why: A black belt anchors a pale outfit so it never looks washed out.

name: The Summer Knit, by the Sea
pieces: The same striped knit and ripped cream jeans, with a white vest, black belt and white trainers
colour: Cream and sage against grey pebbles and sea
why: A good summer knit travels well, from the hallway mirror to the beach.
alt: Dheeraj in a striped knit shirt and ripped cream jeans, walking along a pebble beach with an island village behind him

name: Marina at Sunset
pieces: A monochrome knit shirt over a black tee, black shorts and dark trainers
colour: Black and cream against a gold sky
why: A clean silhouette still reads when the light is behind you.
alt: Dheeraj in a short sleeve knit shirt and shorts, silhouetted against a sunset over a marina
